preconditions.description: The number of suspects n is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.
The number of truthful suspects m is between 0 and n inclusive.
The input contains exactly n+1 lines (first line with n and m, followed by n lines of answers).

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.strip()) >= 2 and line.strip()[0] in '+-' and line.strip()[1:].isdigit() for line in lines[1:])
preconditions.description: Each of the n answer lines starts with '+' or '-' followed by a valid integer representing a suspect index.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.strip()[1:]) <= n for line in lines[1:])
preconditions.description: Every suspect index mentioned in the answers is between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: sum(1 for c in range(1, n+1) if count_truthful(c) == m) >= 1
preconditions.description: It is guaranteed that at least one suspect exists such that if they committed the crime, exactly m people told the truth.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n lines, one for each suspect.

postconditions.expression: all(line in ['Truth', 'Lie', 'Not defined'] for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is exactly 'Truth', 'Lie', or 'Not defined'.

postconditions.expression: all((output_lines[i] == 'Truth') == (all(is_truthful(i, c) for c in valid_criminals)) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: For each suspect i, the output is 'Truth' if and only if suspect i told the truth in every valid scenario (i.e., for every possible criminal c that satisfies the condition of exactly m truthful answers).

postconditions.expression: all((output_lines[i] == 'Lie') == (all(not is_truthful(i, c) for c in valid_criminals)) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: For each suspect i, the output is 'Lie' if and only if suspect i lied in every valid scenario.

postconditions.expression: all((output_lines[i] == 'Not defined') == (any(is_truthful(i, c) for c in valid_criminals) and any(not is_truthful(i, c) for c in valid_criminals)) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: For each suspect i, the output is 'Not defined' if and only if suspect i told the truth in at least one valid scenario and lied in at least one valid scenario.
